rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: The INC website heads the letter 'Text of the resignation letter written by the Congress President Smt. Sonia Gandhi to the Congress Working Committee', and in the letter, signed Sonia Gandhi, she writes that she tenders her resignation 'from the post of the Party President'.

rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: In the letter she writes that at that morning's meeting of the Working Committee 'certain of my colleagues expressed views to the effect that my having been born elsewhere is a liability to the Congress Party', and that she therefore tenders her resignation from the post of the Party President while continuing to serve the Party as a member.
